How quinceañera transportation works here

Most families book a chauffeured hourly charter that follows the celebration: pickup at home or the salon, arrival at the church or Mass, a formal photo stop, then a reception entrance with the quinceañera and her court together. With Scottsdale Sprinters, stops are complimentary on an hourly charter because you have already reserved the time. Share passenger count, addresses, and a guardian contact when you book so the chauffeur runs one written schedule for the day.

What it costs (before tax)

Scottsdale Sprinters publishes hourly rates from $145 to $325 for the vehicles on this page, with a 4-hour minimum on every one of them except the 56-Passenger Motorcoach (5 hours). A 5-hour evening in the Pink Hummer Limo (18) is $1,475 before tax; in the Party Bus (28 Pax) it is $1,250 before tax; in the Limo Lounge Party Sprinter it is $875 before tax. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout, and on a card a 50% deposit holds the date. You book the whole vehicle — the fare does not change with headcount.

Which vehicle for her court

Match the vehicle to everyone who must ride together — then start at the top. The Pink Hummer Limo seats 18 and leads this list: it is the statement entrance, and the one families picture first. The party cabins come next — they seat 13–28 passengers per vehicle: the Party Bus (28 Pax), Limo Lounge Party Sprinter, Limo Party Sprinter (13 Pax) and Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter. When parents, padrinos and guests ride too, the shuttles and coaches seat 14–56 passengers per vehicle: the Executive Black Sprinter, Executive White Sprinter, Mini Bus (24 Pax), Grech Executive Mini Coach (27 Pax), Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) and 56-Passenger Motorcoach. That second vehicle keeps the family on the same schedule when the court fills the one she rides in.

A sample quinceañera transportation timeline

Every quince day is different, but the rhythm is usually the same: get her and the court loaded without crushing the gown, arrive at Mass on time, leave room for photos, and pull up to the reception as one group. We put that into one written schedule with a designated guardian contact — the same operational approach we use for prom night. The times below are an example, not a fixed itinerary.

Home or salon pickup

Start with a buffer. Gowns, heels, and a full court take longer to load than a dinner party. Your chauffeur assists with boarding, confirms the day’s stop list, and keeps the cabin cool and ready. Soft drinks for guests under 21; music and lights are welcome once everyone is settled.

Church / Mass arrival

We time the drop for the ceremony start — not “sometime around then.” The vehicle waits or holds per the hours you booked. If padrinos or parents need a separate arrival window, that is a good reason to add a second vehicle rather than splitting the court across rideshares.

Formal photos

Park, resort, Old Town, or a desert backdrop — photo stops fit inside an hourly charter because you have already bought the time. Tell us the spot when you book so the chauffeur can stage curb access and keep the schedule honest. Confetti and food stay outside the cabin (ride rules).

Reception grand entrance

The court arrives together. That curb moment is half the point of a dedicated vehicle: doors open, lights on, everyone in frame. We coordinate the pull-up with your planner or DJ contact if you share one.

End-of-night returns

Within the reserved hours, we return the birthday girl and court to homes or hotels on the schedule. If the reception runs long, extend before the clock runs out — same published hourly rate, subject to availability.

Example 5-hour block (illustrative only — not a published schedule): 2:30 p.m. salon pickup → 3:30 p.m. church → 5:00 p.m. photo stop → 6:30 p.m. reception entrance → returns as booked. Swap times for your Mass and venue; the structure holds.

Parent peace-of-mind: chauffeurs, rules, under-21 clarity

Every trip runs with a licensed, insured chauffeur, and every vehicle is detailed between every trip — not at the end of the day. That matters when the cabin has to look right for photos and the reception entrance.

On board, the house rules are short and firm:

Playlist and lights are welcome. A chaperone or guardian cell on the reservation is recommended so the chauffeur has one point of contact if timing shifts — same practice as our prom night experience. Adult guests on a separate vehicle who want the legal landscape can read our Arizona party bus alcohol guide; we keep this page focused on a teen celebration done right.

  • No underage drinking — guests under 21 stay on soft drinks
  • Alcohol only for 21+
  • No smoking or vaping — $1,500 fee (the smell does not leave)
  • No food inside the vehicle
  • Cleaning fee $450 for excessive mess, or for a deep clean if someone is sick

Frequently asked questions

Can we do multiple stops — home, salon, church, photos, and reception?

Yes. On an hourly charter, stops are complimentary because you have already reserved the time. Share the full stop list when you book so one written schedule covers the day.

Is music or Bluetooth available?

Cabin features vary by vehicle. Party Sprinters and the party bus are built for playlist and lights; executive Sprinters are quieter. Check the individual fleet page for the vehicle you want, or ask reservations.

Can we add decorations?

Ask before you pay. Decorations and vehicle-specific requests are confirmed in writing. Confetti and food stay outside the cabin per ride rules. Bottled water is complimentary on every ride; other add-ons are quoted at checkout.

Should parents or padrinos book a second vehicle?

If the court fills the primary vehicle, yes — a second Sprinter, a mini bus, or the 56-Passenger Motorcoach keeps family on the same timeline without splitting the birthday girl’s entrance. Many families treat it like wedding guest transport.

What is the deposit and cancellation policy?

How the rest settles depends on how you pay: on a card, a 50% deposit holds the date and your written confirmation sets out the balance and its timing; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk opens that same checkout. Cancel 14 or more days before pickup for a full refund on standard bookings; between 72 hours and 14 days we keep the deposit; inside 72 hours the reservation is non-refundable. Large groups and multi-vehicle bookings (20+ passengers or 2 or more vehicles) use a longer window — full refund 30+ days out. See policies for the complete terms, including major-event dates.

Do you have Spanish-speaking help?

Yes — call or text (623) 986-6339 and ask for Spanish assistance. This English page remains the primary booking URL.

How is this different from a birthday or prom ride?

Same chauffeured fleet and hourly pricing. Quince days usually need more stops (church + photos + reception) and a clearer under-21 rules conversation with parents. Related: prom night, homecoming transportation, birthday party Sprinter.

¿Cómo funciona el transporte para una quinceañera en Scottsdale o Phoenix?

La mayoría de las familias reserva un charter por hora: recogida en casa o salón, llegada a la iglesia o Misa, parada para fotos formales y entrada a la recepción con la quinceañera y su corte juntas. En Scottsdale Sprinters, las paradas en un charter por hora están incluidas porque usted ya reservó el tiempo.

¿Cuánto cuesta?

Tarifas publicadas para estos vehículos de $145 a $325 por hora, con mínimo de 4 horas (5 horas en el 56-Passenger Motorcoach). Ejemplo: 5 horas en el Pink Hummer Limo (18) = $1,475 antes de impuestos; Party Bus (28 Pax) = $1,250; Limo Lounge Party Sprinter = $875. Se agrega 8% de impuesto de Arizona; con tarjeta, un depósito del 50% asegura la fecha.

¿Qué tamaño de vehículo necesitamos?

Elija según quienes deben viajar juntos, y empiece por arriba. Entrada llamativa: Pink Hummer Limo (18). Luego los party buses y las limusinas Sprinter: Party Bus (28 Pax), Limo Lounge Party Sprinter, Limo Party Sprinter (13 Pax), Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter (13–28 asientos). Para la familia y los invitados, las vans ejecutivas y los coaches (14–56 asientos): Executive Black Sprinter, Executive White Sprinter, Mini Bus (24 Pax), Grech Executive Mini Coach (27 Pax), Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax), 56-Passenger Motorcoach. Padres o padrinos pueden agregar un segundo vehículo: 56-Passenger Motorcoach.

¿Cómo reservamos?

En línea en scottsdalesprinters.com/pricing, o llame / envíe mensaje al (623) 986-6339, o escriba a reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com. Tenga lista la fecha, número de pasajeros, direcciones de iglesia / fotos / recepción, hora de recogida y un celular de un tutor o adulto responsable.

¿Se permite alcohol si hay menores de 21?

Solo para mayores de 21. Menores de 21 solo bebidas sin alcohol. Sin fumar ni vapear ($1,500). Sin comida dentro del vehículo. Reglas completas: scottsdalesprinters.com/ride-rules.
